Class EventDispatcher

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.events.EventDispatcher
public class EventDispatcher extends Object
The EventDispatcher class manages the registration and firing of model events to appropriate listeners.

It supports multiple listeners for each event type and ensures that listeners are notified when an event they subscribed to is triggered.
